documents.name: F_COLLECTION-permit.txt
documents.text:
For Scene 811, the historical exhibit must remain in acid-free handling trays, a signed collection-loan agreement must be presented, and an accredited collections technician must stay beside the display throughout the take.

Scene 812 interview recording requires written interview-location release.

Last season's footage catalogue records an old permit and a former escort; these are historical references only.

An unsigned draft for Scene 812 proposes a smoke cordon observer; no current duty or approval is imposed by that draft.
